name: DreamAvatar
definition: A diffusion-based 3D avatar model generation method with text guidance, using an SMPL model as a shape prior and text-guided 2D image generation via diffusion to create training data in a DreamFusion-like 3D generation pipeline combining NeRF and diffusion.
summary: DreamAvatar generates animatable 3D human avatars from text prompts by combining SMPL shape priors with NeRF optimization, ensuring anatomical correctness unlike unconstrained methods.
